messages:
Anna: quick idea — compress the deploy flow for hotfixes (<5 files). One command to pin + deploy + proto release notes.
Mike: nice. can it include an escape hatch? e.g. `/deploy --dryrun --pin v1234 --on-failure rollback:previous`
Anna: yep thinking `/deploy hotfix --pin=auto --notes=stub` that creates a stub note and pins the manifest.
Jess: check change windows — we need calendar gating and a CLI prompt if outside window. can't auto-ship during blackout.
Sam: +1. propose `--wait-for-window` that queries our cal integration and prompts in bot. if forced, requires `--confirm-really`.
Anna: good. also want a shorthand for rollbacks: `/deploy rollback --to=manifest@2026-03-01 --reason="regression"`
Mike: can the bot create a changelog entry and attach a minimal checklist to release notes? small JSON blob with checks.
Anna: sample template I sketched:
```
notes: |
  - summary: short one-liner
  - impact: low/medium/high
  - rollback-plan: one-liner
  - owner: @<owner>
```
Sam: 👍 also add `--auto-pin-ttl` so pins expire after X hours unless promoted.
deploy-bot: [action] preview for `/deploy hotfix --pin=auto --notes=stub --wait-for-window`
```
Pin: manifest@v8912
Dry-run: true
Release notes stub created at /releases/drafts/8912
Calendar: window open in 4h
```
Jess: looks good. for staging we should default shorter ttl and require manual promote for prod.
Mike: let's prototype CLI flags and a bot shortcut that expands to a modal for owners.
Anna: ok who can own prototype? Sam can take CLI, Mike will wire bot modal, Jess will add calendar gating.
Sam: taking CLI. ETA EOW for a PoC in staging.
Mike: will mock modal by EOW too. I'll add a small UX for the confirm flow.
Anna: thanks — we'll run one test hotfix next Tue in the 09:00 change window. tagging @eng-releases for visibility :eyes:
Mike: noted.
Jess: adding checklist doc to the release repo now.
Sam: created PR #234 with CLI skeleton (staging flag only).
Anna: perfect. merging plan: staging test -> gather metrics (deploy time, pin behavior) -> roll to prod if clean.
Mike: fallback: bot will auto-run `/deploy rollback --to=manifest@<prev>` on three consecutive errors.
Anna: capture telemetry for that. end-to-end logs to be sent to /logs/deploys.
deploy-bot: scheduled test deploy in staging for Tue 09:00 UTC, owners: @Anna @Sam @Mike
Anna: good job team. we'll iterate after the run.
